blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech-LLMs are expensive to run, making compression important for real-world deployment. However, compressed models are usually selected using aggregate word error rate (WER), which can hide how pruning affects different demographic groups. In this work, we systematically study the effect of audio encoder pruning on SLAM-ASR for different demographic groups. Using the Fair-Speech and Common Voice datasets, we found that the pruning does not affect all demographic groups equally; the gap between best- and worst-performing groups increases in fold. These disparities appear across all three encoder scales, but only the largest model initially hides them behind aggregate WER. LoRA adaptation improves WER for every group, but benefits groups already performing well more strongly and widens for certain groups. On Common Voice English, Danish, and Dutch, accent gaps persist but do not clearly widen, showing that the fairness effects of pruning vary across datasets and must be measured directly. Our findings suggest that for pruned models, deployment decisions should include per-group WER, with the worst-performing group’s error rate as an explicit criterion.
blocks.zh: Speech-LLMs运行昂贵,使得压缩对于现实世界的部署很重要. 然而,压缩模型通常使用集合词误差率(WER)来选择,这可以隐藏pruning如何影响不同的人口组别. 在这项工作中,我们系统地研究音频编码器对不同人口群体SAM-ASR的影响。 使用Fair-Speech和Common Voice的数据集,我们发现,普鲁因并不平等地影响所有人口群体;表现最佳和表现最差群体之间的差距在叠加上增加。 这些差异出现在所有三个编码器尺度上,但只有最大的模型最初将它们隐藏在聚合WER后面. LORA的适应改进了每个群体的WER,但受益群体已经表现较好,对某些群体也扩大了。 在通用语音英语,丹麦语和荷兰语中,口音差距依然存在,但并没有明显扩大,这表明,套音的公平效果因数据集而异,必须直接衡量. 我们的研究结果表明,对于被套用的模式,部署决定应当包括每个组的WER,表现最差组的误差率是明确的标准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcribes spoken language, and it is used in voice assistants, dictation tools, and captioning services ( Koenecke et al., 2020 ) . The field’s current dominant architecture is the Speech-LLM: a pretrained speech encoder coupled to a large language model through a lightweight projector. These stacks are generally large, making them computationally expensive, and model compression has become a routine step between training and deploying.
blocks.zh: 自动语音识别(ASR)转录口语,用于语音助理,拼写工具和字幕服务(Koenecke等人,2020年). 该字段目前的主导架构是Speech-LLM:通过轻量级投影仪将预训的语音编码器与大型语言模型结合. 这些堆栈一般都很大,使其计算成本昂贵,模型压缩也成为训练与部署之间的例行步骤.

blocks.en: One of the widely used compression techniques is pruning. Usually, a pruned model is validated on aggregate word error rate (WER). However, ASR systems are already performing unevenly across demographic groups ( Koenecke et al., 2020 ) . That means an aggregated WER hides group disparities. In that case, when we apply pruning to those models, the question will be: what does pruning do to that unevenness? 1 1 1 Code is available at https://github.com/KarthikKolluriKB/SpeechLLM-Pruning-Fairness
blocks.zh: 被广泛使用的压缩技术之一是螺旋. 通常情况下,一个被打磨过的模型会被验证在聚合字错误率(WER)上. 然而,不同人口群体中,ASR系统的表现并不均衡(Koenecke等人,2020年)。 这意味着一个汇总的WER隐藏了群体差异. 那样的话,当我们把这些模型应用到这些模型上时,问题将是:这些模型对于这种不平衡有什么作用? 1 1 代码见https://github.com/KarthikKolluriKB/SpeechLLM-Pruning-Fairness

blocks.en: We study this effect systematically in the SLAM-ASR pipeline ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) : a frozen Whisper encoder Radford et al. (2022) , a trainable projector, and a frozen Qwen2.5-3B decoder Qwen et al. (2025) connected together as an ASR pipeline. We experiment on three Whisper scales (12, 24, and 32 encoder layers), prune each encoder top-down two layers at a time, and retrain the projector at every depth, so each configuration is a deployable model. This pipeline is demographically blind: no group label enters training, pruning, or LoRA adaptation. Our primary corpus is Fair-Speech ( Veliche et al., 2024 ) , which offers the richest demographic schema, and we add Common Voice English, Dutch, and Danish for cross-lingual study.

blocks.en: Our results answer these questions as follows. Pruning amplifies the racial disparity on the largest model (RQ1). The gap between Black and Asian speakers grows from 13.5 to 24.5 percentage points (pp) by eight removed layers, even though the first prune improves aggregate WER. The disparity exists at every encoder scale: on all three models, the worst-performing group starts with roughly twice the WER of the best-performing. Concealment, however, appears only at the largest scale (RQ2). On the small and medium models, the first prune raises aggregate WER by 10.8 and 2.3 pp, respectively. So the damage is already visible in the aggregate. Across languages, the accent gaps on Common Voice English and Dutch persist under pruning but do not amplify. Finally, LoRA improves aggregate WER at every depth but widens the Black-to-Asian ratio at every matched depth (RQ3): it recovers accuracy for every group, but better for the groups the model already performs well on and worse for the groups it performs worse on.

blocks.en: Our findings carry a direct practical message: aggregate WER cannot validate a pruned speech model as fair. Deployment decisions for compressed speech models should therefore include per-group WER, with explicit attention to the worst-performing group. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of how structural encoder pruning in Speech-LLM affects demographic disparity across pruning depth, model scale, and LoRA adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果包含一个直接的实用信息:集合WER无法验证一个被扭曲的语音模型是公平的. 因此,压缩语音模型的部署决定应当包括每个组的WER,明确关注表现最差的组. 据我们所知,这是关于Speak-LLM中结构编码器的穿透如何影响整个穿透深度、模型规模和LORA适应性的人口差距的第一次系统研究。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Bias in ASR
blocks.zh: 2.1 ASR中的偏见

blocks.en: Performance disparities across speaker groups are well documented in ASR. Koenecke et al. (2020) found that five commercial systems transcribed speech from Black speakers with an average word error rate (WER) of 35%, against 19% for white speakers, and traced the gap to the underlying acoustic models, since it persisted on a matched subset of identical phrases. Subsequent work investigated the linguistic mechanisms behind this disparity, linking errors to morpho-syntactic features of African American English such as habitual “be” ( Martin and Tang, 2020 ) and to ethnicity-related dialectal variation more broadly ( Wassink et al., 2022 ) . Disparities along gender and dialect lines were reported earlier ( Tatman, 2017 ; Tatman and Kasten, 2017 ) , and Feng et al. (2021) systematically quantified bias across gender, age, regional accent, and non-native speech; we adopt this per-group WER evaluation. These imbalances persist in large pretrained models: evaluations of Whisper ( Radford et al., 2022 ) report higher accuracy for North American than for British or Australian accents, and for native than for non-native speech, with WER associated with speaker sex, first-language typology, and second-language proficiency ( Graham and Roll, 2024 ) . Performance gaps for child speakers likewise persist across Whisper scales ( Attia et al., 2023 ) . To measure such gaps systematically, corpora with speaker demographics have emerged: Common Voice collects optional self-reported accent, gender, and age at scale ( Ardila et al., 2019 ) , the Edinburgh corpus targets accent diversity ( Sanabria et al., 2023 ) , and Fair-Speech provides the richest schema of the three, covering age, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic status, and geographic variation ( Veliche et al., 2024 ) . We justify our choice among these in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 发言群体之间的业绩差异在ASR中有详细记录。 Koenecke等人(2020年)发现,5个商业系统转录了来自黑人演说者的语音,平均字误率(WER)为35%,而白人演说者为19%,并将这一差距追溯到基本的声学模型上,因为它一直停留在匹配的一组相同短语上. 随后的工作调查了这种差异背后的语言机制,将错误与非裔美国人英语的morpho-yntactic特征,如习惯性“be”(Martin和Tang,2020年)以及与族裔有关的方言差异(Wassink等人,2022年)联系起来。 性别和方言线上的差异在较早时有所报道(Tatman,2017年;Tatman和Kasten,2017年),冯等人. (2021) 系统量化性别、年龄、区域口音和非母语的偏见;我们采用这种每组WER评价。 这些不平衡在大型的预训模型中持续存在:对Whisper的评价(Radford等人,2022年)报告北美的准确度高于英国或澳大利亚的口音,对本土的准确度也高于非本土语,WER与演说性,第一语言类型,以及第二语言能力相关(Graham and Roll,2024年). 同样,在Whisper比例表(Attia等人,2023年)中,儿童演讲者的表现差距依然存在。 为了系统地衡量这种差距,已经出现了与演讲者人口统计有关的公司: 常见 声音收集可选的自报口音,性别和年龄尺度(Ardila等人,2019年),爱丁堡神话针对口音多样性(Sanabria等人,2023年),Fair-Speech提供三种语言中最丰富的方案,涵盖年龄,性别,种族,社会经济地位,地理差异(Veliche等人,2024年). 我们有理由在第3节中作出选择。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model Compression, Scale, and Bias
blocks.zh: 2.2 模型压缩、缩放和比亚斯

blocks.en: How model compression affects bias is still an open question, with outcomes that vary by method, domain, and demographic axis. In computer vision, Hooker et al. (2020) demonstrated that pruning and quantization can amplify bias: minimal changes in overall accuracy may hide substantial errors affecting a small subset of under-represented examples, an observation that supports evaluating worst-group rather than average performance ( Sagawa et al., 2019 ) . Tran et al. (2022) attributed such disparities to differences in gradient norms and decision-boundary distance across groups, while Iofinova et al. (2023) found that, although moderate pruning need not increase bias, disparities for specific protected attributes emerge at high sparsity.
blocks.zh: 模型压缩如何影响偏差仍然是一个未决问题,其结果因方法,域,人口轴而异. 在计算机视觉中,Hooker等人(2020年)证明,推敲和量化可以扩大偏差:总体准确度的微小变化可能掩盖影响少数代表性不足的例子的重大错误,这种观察支持评价最差组别而不是平均性能(Sagawa等人,2019年)。 特兰等人. (2022年)将这种差异归因于梯度规范和不同群体之间决定边界距离的差异,而Iofinova等人(2023年)发现,虽然温和的挤压不需要增加偏差,但在高伸缩度时会出现特定保护属性的差异.

blocks.en: In LLMs, compression’s effect on fairness depends on the base model and method ( Ramesh et al., 2023 ) , but two direct comparisons find pruning riskier than quantization, for protected groups ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and for trustworthiness ( Hong et al., 2024 ) , and compression’s effect on social bias varies with model scale ( Gonçalves and Strubell, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在LLMs中,压缩对公平性的影响取决于基本模型和方法(Ramesh等人,2023年),但两次直接比较发现,对于受保护群体(徐等人,2024年)和可信赖性(Hong等人,2024年)而言,压缩对社会偏见的影响因模型尺度(Gonçalves and Strubell,2023年)不同而不同.

blocks.en: In speech, evidence on compression and bias is scarce. Lin et al. (2024b) examined self-supervised models under pruning and distillation, finding, in embedding-level probes, that distillation increased gender bias while decreasing age bias, whereas row pruning reduced bias. For speech-LLMs, bias studies either examine response content ( Lin et al., 2024c ; Lin et al., 2024a ) or benchmark WER disparities across architectures: Ginjala et al. (2026) evaluated nine models spanning CTC, encoder-decoder, and LLM-decoder designs and reported that the audio encoder, more than language model scale, governs fairness.
blocks.zh: 在言论中,压缩和偏执的证据很少. Lin等人(2024年b)在喷发和蒸馏下检查了自我监督的模型,发现在嵌入层探测器中,蒸馏会增加性别偏见,同时减少年龄偏见,而排喷则减少偏见。 对于语音-LLMs,偏差研究要么检查响应内容(Lin等人,2024c;Lin等人,2024a),要么基准WER跨架构差异:Ginjala等人(2026年)评价了跨越CTC,编码器-解码器,以及LLM-解码器设计的9种模型,并报告说音频编码器比语言模型尺度更能规范公平.

blocks.en: We build directly on Kolluri et al. (2026) , who pruned Whisper encoder layers in the speech-LLM ( Ma et al., 2024 ) and showed that removing a few layers costs little aggregate WER and that LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) recovers the unpruned baseline’s WER; that study reports aggregate WER only. How adaptation affects fairness is itself unexplored: Ding et al. (2024) found no consistent subgroup effect of LoRA relative to full fine-tuning; low-rank adaptation can propagate non-demographic biases inherited from noisy pretraining data ( Chang et al., 2026 ) ; and fine-tuning aimed at under-represented speakers lowers their WER ( Shekoufandeh et al., 2025 ) , suggesting repair depends on where adaptation is aimed. No prior work examines whether encoder pruning shifts demographic disparity in a speech-LLM’s transcriptions, or whether LoRA’s recovery is shared evenly across groups; we address both.
blocks.zh: Koluri等人(2026年)在语音LLM(Ma等人,2024年)中修饰了Whisper编码器层, 并显示去除几层热电联产成本很少, 适应如何影响公平本身没有加以探讨: Ding等人(2024年)没有发现LORA相对于全面微调的一贯子群效应;低等级的适应可以传播从噪音预训数据中继承的非人口偏差(Chang等人,2026年);针对代表人数不足的发言者的微调会降低他们的WER(Shekoufandeh等人,2025年),这表明修复取决于适应的目标所在。 先前没有研究过编码器在语音-LLM的文字记录中是否改变人口差异,或者LORA的恢复是否在各群体之间均匀共享;我们同时讨论这两个问题。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 System and Pruning
blocks.zh: 3.1 系统和运行

blocks.en: We follow the SLAM-ASR architecture Ma et al. (2024) : a Whisper encoder Radford et al. (2022) feeds a small trainable projector (ConcatLinear), which maps audio representations into a frozen Qwen2.5-3B decoder Qwen et al. (2025) . We hold the LLM fixed so that encoder capacity is the only varied component; both the encoder and the LLM stay frozen, and only the projector and LoRA adapters are trained. To treat encoder capacity as an experimental variable, we run the full procedure with three Whisper variants, Small (12 layers), Medium (24), and Large-v2 (32), each paired with the same projector and LLM. As in Kolluri et al. (2026) , we prune each variant top-down, removing two layers at a time, and report pruning as the absolute number of layers removed (L-2, L-4, …). The projector is retrained at every depth, so each configuration is a fully retrained, deployable system rather than a fixed model probed after pruning.

blocks.en: The models never see demographic labels: training and model selection use aggregate WER alone. In practice, this is also how pruned models are judged, since compression work reports aggregate WER and stops there. Our question is what this number hides: does pruning damage the WER of individual demographic groups even when the aggregate looks fine? To answer it, we take each pruned model after training and evaluate it separately for every demographic group on the evaluation corpora.

blocks.en: Training data: The projector and LoRA adapters are trained on Common Voice 22 Ardila et al. (2019) , a crowdsourced multilingual read-speech corpus, following the same training configuration as Kolluri et al. (2026) . We use the official train and test splits without modification, so speakers are disjoint across splits by construction, and the counts reported in Table 1 are those remaining after the duration filter described below. Our primary system uses the English subset (100 hours); for the cross-lingual analysis, we additionally train separate systems on the Danish (4.2 hours) and Dutch (54 hours) subsets, which span an order-of-magnitude range in training data.
blocks.zh: 培训数据: 该放映机和LORA适配器在Common Voice 22 Ardila et al. (2019)上接受过训练,这是一个多语种的多语种读写机,采用与Koluri et al. (2026)相同的训练配置. 我们使用正式的列车和测试分数而不做修改,因此扬声器在建筑分数之间脱节,表1中报告的计数是以下描述的时间过滤后剩余的计数. 我们的初级系统使用英语子集(100小时);为了进行跨语言分析,我们额外在丹麦语子集(4.2小时)和荷兰语子集(54小时)上训练单独的系统,这些子集在培训数据中跨越一个放大范围。

blocks.en: Evaluation data and demographic axes: We aim to evaluate as many demographic axes as possible. To this end, we selected two datasets: Fair-Speech Veliche et al. (2024) and Common Voice 22 Ardila et al. (2019) . Fair-Speech Veliche et al. (2024) is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark built specifically to expose demographic disparities in speech recognition, and it carries the richest bias annotation of our corpora. Across 26,417 utterances, it labels ethnicity (seven analyzable groups), socio-economic status , gender, age, and first language. Fair-Speech is used exclusively for evaluation and contributes no training data. Common Voice 22 Ardila et al. (2019) (CV-22) is a large multilingual crowdsourced corpus of read speech in which contributors may optionally self-report speaker attributes. We use this metadata to measure disparities by accent , gender , and age on the English, Danish, and Dutch splits, which allowed us to compare results across languages. Because these attributes are optional, group-level results on CV-22 are computed over the subset of test utterances carrying the relevant annotation, which is smaller than the full test split. The dataset statistics and supported demographic axes are presented in Table 1 and Table 2 respectively.
blocks.zh: 评价数据和人口轴: 我们的目标是评估尽可能多的人口轴心。 为此,我们选择了两个数据集:Fair-Speech Veliche等人(2024年)和Common Voice 22 Ardila等人(2019年). Fair-Speech Veliche等人(2024年)是专门为暴露语音识别方面的人口差异而建立的综合评价基准,它载有我们公司最丰富的偏见。 在26 417个语言中,它标注种族(七个可分析群体)、社会经济地位、性别、年龄和第一语言。 Fair-Speech专用于评价,不提供培训数据。 Community Voice 22 Ardila et al. blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Model Architecture. Our system follows SLAM-ASR Ma et al. (2024) and comprises three components: a Whisper speech encoder Radford et al. (2022) , a lightweight ConcatLinear projector, and a Qwen2.5-3B LLM Qwen et al. (2025) . We run it with three Whisper encoder variants, Small (12 layers), Medium (24), and Large-v2 (32), each paired with the same projector and LLM.
blocks.zh: 模型建筑. 我们的系统遵循SLAM-ASR Ma等人(2024年),由三个部分组成:Whisper语音编码器Radford等人(2022年),轻量级ConcatLinear投影仪,以及Quen2.5-3B LLM Quen等 (2025) (中文(简体) ). 我们运行它有三个Whisper编码器变体,小(12层),中(24层)和大(32层),每个变体都配有相同的投影仪和LLM.

blocks.en: Projector. The projector is a two-layer MLP with concatenation-based temporal downsampling: it concatenates five consecutive frames, reducing the sequence length five times, then applies two linear layers with ReLU and dropout 0.1 (hidden dimension 2048), followed by LayerNorm to match the scale of the LLM text embeddings. The projector is reinitialized and retrained from scratch at every pruning depth rather than fine-tuned from the unpruned checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 投影仪 投影仪是两层的MLP,以凝聚为主的时下取样:它连续5帧,连续5次缩短序列长度,然后应用两个带有ReLU和troute 0.1的线性层(隐藏维度2048),之后是TyleNorm,以匹配LLM文本嵌入的尺度. 投影仪在每一个穿孔深度都重新启动和从头重新训练,而不是从没有穿孔的检查站进行微调。

blocks.en: LoRA. We apply LoRA Hu et al. (2021) to the query, key, value, and output projections of all LLM attention layers. To limit overfitting on smaller datasets, we set the rank per resource level: r = 8 r{=}8 , α = 16 \alpha{=}16 for Danish (low-resource) and r = 16 r{=}16 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 for Dutch and English; r = 16 r{=}16 on Danish overfit in preliminary runs, motivating the reduced rank. LoRA modules use dropout 0.1, adding roughly 0.8M ( r = 8 r{=}8 ) and 1.5M ( r = 16 r{=}16 ) trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 罗拉。 将LORA Hu等人(2021年)应用于所有LLM注意力层的查询,密钥,值和输出预测. 为了限制在较小的数据集上的偏差,我们设定了每个资源水平的级别:r = 8 r{=}8,α = 16\alpha{=}16为丹麦语(低资源),r = 16 r{=}16,α = 32\alpha{=}32为荷兰语和英语;r = 16 r{=}16为丹麦语在初步运行中的偏差,激励降级. LoRA模块使用退出0.1,增加了大约0.8M(r = 8 r{=}8)和1.5M(r = 16 r{=}16)可训练参数.

blocks.en: Training Details. All models are trained with AdamW Loshchilov and Hutter (2019) at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.01, and gradient clipping 1.0, under a cosine schedule with linear warmup over the first 5% of steps, in bfloat16 on a single NVIDIA A6000 (48 GB). The Whisper encoder and Qwen2.5-3B weights remain frozen; only the projector and, where enabled, the LoRA adapters are updated. For English configurations, we use a batch size of 8 and train for 2 epochs, or 4 with LoRA. Dutch uses a batch size of 8 and Danish a batch size of 4, with more passes over the smaller corpora; per-configuration epoch counts are given in Appendix A . Training stops early on validation WER, so model selection uses aggregate validation performance alone, with no demographic label involved. Every pruning depth within a setting uses the same setup, so depths differ only in encoder size. All runs use a single seed (42), so we rely on the paired bootstrap in Section 3.4 rather than variance across seeds.
blocks.zh: 训练详情。 所有模型都与AdamW Loshchilov和Hutter(2019年)一起接受训练,学习速度为1×10−4 1\times 10^{-4}体重衰减0.01,梯度剪切1.0,在前5%的步数上,按照一个有线性暖和的余弦表,在单NVIDIA A6000(48GB)上的bfloat16. Whisper编码器和Quen2.5-3B重量仍然处于冷冻状态;只有投影仪和在启用时,LORA适配器被更新. 对于英语配置,我们使用8的批量尺寸和2个世纪的列车,或4与Lora. 荷兰使用的批量尺寸为8个,丹麦的批量尺寸为4个,比较小的蝎子还要多;每个装配时代的计数载于附录A。 训练在验证WER早期就停止了,所以模型选择只使用集合验证性能,不涉及人口标签. 设置内的每一螺旋深度使用相同的设置,因此深度仅在编码器大小上有所不同. 所有跑步都使用单一的种子(42),所以我们依靠第3.4节中配对的靴子,而不是不同种子的差异.

blocks.en: Decoding. At inference, the projected audio embeddings are prepended to a fixed plain-text prompt, Transcribe speech to text. , applied without a chat template and held constant across all scales, depths, and languages. Transcriptions are generated with beam search (width 2, no sampling, no repetition or length penalty) up to 128 new tokens, identically for base and LoRA-adapted systems. Checkpoint selection during training uses greedy decoding on the validation split with a repetition penalty of 1.5.
blocks.zh: 解码 推论,预测的音频嵌入准备到一个固定的纯文本提示,将语音转换到文本.,在没有聊天模板的情况下应用,并保持所有尺度、深度和语言的恒定. 通过光束搜索(宽度2,无取样,无重复或长度惩罚)生成的转录最多128个新符,对于基数和LORA调整后的系统相同. 训练期间的检查站选择使用对验证分拆的贪婪解码,重复处罚为1.5.

blocks.en: Baselines. The unpruned ( L L -0) system at each encoder scale is the reference for every pruned configuration at that scale, so configurations differ only in encoder depth and in the projector retrained at that depth. LoRA comparisons are matched the same way, against the base system at the same scale and depth. We report no external ASR baseline, since our claim concerns how a fixed pipeline behaves under compression rather than how it compares against other systems.
blocks.zh: 基线。 每个编码器尺度的未pruned(L L - 0)系统是该尺度上每个被pruned配置的参考,因此配置仅在编码器深度和该深度重新训练的投影器上有所不同. 洛拉比较以同样的方式与同样规模和深度的基础系统进行比对。 我们没有报告外部ASR基线,因为我们的声称涉及的是固定管道在压缩下的表现,而不是它与其他系统相比的情况。

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价细节

blocks.en: We evaluate every configuration with WER: aggregate WER is computed over the full evaluation set, and a group’s WER over the utterances spoken by members of that group, so every group is scored by the same rule.
blocks.zh: 我们用WER来评价每个配置:集合WER通过完整的评价集计算,一个组的WER通过该组成员所说的话来评价,因此每个组的得分都相同。

blocks.en: We assess disparity with three measures, fixed before the analysis: the worst-group WER at each depth as our primary measure, the absolute gap Δ = WER worst − WER best \Delta=\mathrm{WER}_{\text{worst}}-\mathrm{WER}_{\text{best}} in percentage points (pp), and the disparity ratio ρ = WER worst / WER best \rho=\mathrm{WER}_{\text{worst}}/\mathrm{WER}_{\text{best}} as a scale-free check; within a group we report relative degradation WER L ​ x / WER L ​ 0 \mathrm{WER}_{Lx}/\mathrm{WER}_{L0} . Since Δ \Delta and ρ \rho diverge by construction when all groups degrade together, we report both at every depth, tracking the Black–Asian pair throughout as the worst- and best-served groups. Significance comes from a paired resampling test: we draw 2,000 bootstrap resamples of the utterances, re-score both setups on each, and take p p as the fraction in which the WER difference flips direction. We limit our claims to the usable range, the contiguous depths at which aggregate WER stays at or below 40%, and analyze groups only where they have at least 200 utterances and 30 minutes of audio; smaller groups appear in tables for coverage only.
blocks.zh: 我们用分析前固定的三项措施来评估差异:每深度最差的组WER作为我们的主要衡量标准,绝对差距QQ=WER最差-WER最差-WER最差=WER最差=WER最差=WER最差=WER=Mathrm{WER=Text{在百分点(pp)中最差=WERR最差/WER=MAR=MARM最佳=WER=Text{在最差=WER=WER=Text{在最差=WER=WER=WER=M=WER=L×在WER=0M=WER=L×/M=/WER=L=L0=/M=WER=L==L=L====L===WER=L==L======U=。 因为当所有群体一起退化时, Delta 和 à rho 的构造就不同了, 我们把两者都报告在每一个深度, 意义来自于一个对齐的复标测试:我们绘制了2000个靴子圈的复标,每段重计两个设置,并将p作为WER差异翻转方向的分数. 我们的主张仅限于可用的范围,即WER总量保持在40%或不到40%的毗连深度,并且只分析至少有200个语音和30分钟音频的组;较小的组只出现在表格中以覆盖。

blocks.zh: 4.1 人口分布和差距(RQ1)

blocks.en: We present our results by demographic dimensions, starting with ethnicity. Table 3 presents WER for the seven ethnic groups as we prune Whisper large encoder layers: at L-0 (without pruning), the groups are already far apart, from 13.4% for Native Hawaiian and 13.7% for Asian speakers to 27.2% for Black speakers, twice the Asian rate. The bias already exists before any pruning.
blocks.zh: 我们从种族角度出发,按人口层面介绍我们的成果。 表3列出了七个族群的WER, 因为我们的Prune Whisper大编码层:在L-0(没有刷孔),这些族群已经相距甚远,夏威夷原住民为13.4%,亚语为13.7%,黑人为27.2%,是亚裔的两倍。 偏见已经存在 之前任何螺旋。

blocks.en: As we prune the top two encoder layers, the aggregate WER shows that the model performs slightly better: it falls from 21.6% to 21.1% ( p = .038 p{=}.038 , Table 3 ). The group columns tell a different story: Black speakers are the only group whose error rate rises among other groups ( + 0.9 +0.9 pp, p = .009 p{=}.009 ), Native American speakers improve most ( − 2.5 -2.5 pp, p = .001 p{=}.001 ), and no other group changes significantly ( p ≥ .13 p\geq.13 ). In relative terms, L-2 is closer to baseline on every group (aggregate at 0.98) except the Black group, at 1.03 (Appendix B ). A practitioner relying on aggregate WER alone would see a small win, while the group that started worst has become worse.
blocks.zh: 随着我们推倒前两个编码层,汇总的WER显示,该模型的性能稍好:从21.6%下降到21.1%(p=.038 p{=}038,表3)。 团体栏目讲述不同的故事: 黑人演讲者是唯一一个其错误率在其他群体中上升的群体(+0.9+0.9pp,p=.009p=009p=009),美国原住民演讲者改善最多(-2.5-2.5pp,p=001p=001p=001),其他群体没有显著变化(p=13 p\geq.13). 相对而言,L-2更接近于每个组的基线(汇总为0.98),但黑色组除外,为1.03(附录B.). 仅仅依靠综合WER的从业者就会看到一个小赢家,而开始最糟糕的组别则变得更糟.

blocks.en: At deeper prunes, all groups degrade but at different rates. At L-4 the aggregate has risen to 25.2%, a cost any practitioner would notice, and the groups have begun to separate: Asian speakers are at 16.3% while Black speakers are at 34.3%, a gap of 18.0 pp. At L-6 the aggregate is at 32.0%, within the 40% usability bound, while Black speakers are at 42.8% and Asian speakers are at 22.2%. The same configuration is therefore usable by the aggregate criterion and unusable for its worst-performing group. At L-8, Black speakers are at 51.0% and Asian speakers at 26.5%. Over the full sweep, Black speakers lose 23.8 pp and Asian speakers 12.8 pp, so the gap between them widens from 13.5 pp to 24.5 pp. Aggregate WER is misleading in two ways: it reports an improvement at the first prune (L-2) while the worst-performing group degrades, and it stays within the usability bound at depths where the worst-performing group has already exceeded it.
blocks.zh: 在更深处,所有群体都退化,但速度不同。 L-4的总数上升到25.2%,任何从业人员都会注意到这一费用,这些小组已开始分开: 亚洲语者占16.3%,黑人语者占34.3%,差距为18.0页。 L-6的总数是32.0%,可使用性在40%以内,而说黑人话的人是42.8%,说亚洲话的人是22.2%。 因此,按照总标准,同一配置是可用的,对其表现最差的群体来说是无法使用的。 在L-8,讲黑人语的占51.0%,讲亚洲语的占26.5%。 在整个扫荡中,黑人演说者损失了23.8页,亚洲演说者损失了12.8页,因此他们之间的差距从13.5页扩大到24.5页. 综合WER在两个方面是误导性的:它报告说,第一毛孔(L-2)有所改进,而表现最差的群体则在退化,它在表现最差的群体已经超过它的深度处于可用性范围内。

blocks.en: Ethnicity is not the only axis that moves. Fig. 2 plots the worst-to-best gap for each demographic axis at every depth (per-group values in Table 15 ), and the three remaining axes each do something different. The gender gap grows from 3.3 to 11.1 pp (male speakers disadvantaged in this corpus; Fig. 5 ). The age gap narrows, but only because the oldest group, worst at baseline, degrades slowest (Fig. 7 ). The socioeconomic gap holds steady (Fig. 6 ; Table 15 ): Low-SES speakers start 5.9 pp behind Affluent speakers (ratio 1.36) and stay behind at every depth, and although the raw gap reaches 7.2 pp at L-8, Affluent speakers lose more of their starting accuracy (+83% vs +67%), so the ratio falls to 1.24. Pruning carries the class disparity along unchanged.
blocks.zh: 种族并不是移动的唯一轴心。 图2为每个深度的人口轴(表15中的每组数值)绘制了最差至最佳的差距,其余三个轴各做一些不同的事情。 性别差距从3.3增至11.1页(男性语者在这部法律中处于不利地位;图5)。 年龄差距缩小,但仅仅是因为年龄最大的群体,在基线最差,降解速度最慢(图7)。 社会经济差距保持稳定(图6;表15):低音SES的演讲者开始于流星语(ratio 1.36)的5.9pp之后,并停留在每一深度,虽然原始差距在L-8时达到7.2pp,但流星语的起始精度减少更多(+83%对+67%),因此比例下降到1.24. 普鲁宁的阶级差异没有改变。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results answer RQ1. The disparity is inherited, but the hiding is new: at L-2 the aggregate improves while the worst-performing ethnicity group degrades significantly. Gender amplifies, class persists, age narrows by leveling down; aggregate WER is blind to all three, which is why pruned models need per-group evaluation.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些结果回答了RQ1。 差距是继承的,但隐藏是新的:在L-2级,总体情况有所改善,而表现最差的种族群体则显著下降。 性别放大,阶级持续,年龄通过平整缩小;汇总WER对全部三个都视而不见,这就是为什么被扭曲的模型需要每个组的评价.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Change in WER (percentage points) per subgroup as Whisper large-v2 is pruned top-down, without (a) and with (b) LoRA (Fair-Speech). Warm colors indicate degradation, cool colors indicate improvement, and the bottom row is the aggregate. Black speakers degrade most at nearly every depth in both conditions. LoRA lowers the aggregate everywhere, but it improves only the already better-performing groups: at ten removed layers it recovers 8.0 8.0 pp for Asian speakers and only 3.3 3.3 pp for Black speakers.
blocks.zh: 图4:由于Whisper大V2自上而下,没有(a)和(b)LORA(对讲),每个分组WER(百分比)的变化。 温暖的颜色表示退化,凉爽的颜色表示改进,底行是聚合物. 在这两种情况下,黑人演说者几乎在每一个深度都退化得最多。 LoRA降低各地的总量,但只改善了已经表现较好的组别:在10个被移除的层中,它恢复了亚洲语的8.0 8.0pp,黑人语的只有3.3 3.3pp.

blocks.en: 4.2 The role of encoder scale (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 编码器比例( RQ2) 的作用

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows per-group WER at all three encoder scales. Black speakers have the highest WER in every panel at every depth. What differs across panels is the cost of the first prune. The small model degrades immediately, its aggregate rising by 10.8 pp at two removed layers, and medium by 2.3 pp; large-v2 instead improves by 0.5 pp.
blocks.zh: 图3在所有三个编码器尺度上显示每组WER. 黑色扬声器在每个面板中拥有最高的WER,在每个深度. 不同面板的不同之处在于第一面板的成本。 小型号立即降解,其总和在两层脱落时上升了10.8pp,中层则上升了2.3pp;大V2则上升了0.5pp.

blocks.en: The disparity ratio ρ \rho (Table 4 ) separates the three scales in a way the aggregate does not. Before pruning, they are similarly unequal, with ρ \rho at 1.99 on large-v2, 2.03 on small, and 2.16 on medium, so Black speakers face roughly twice the word error rate of Asian speakers on all the encoder scales. The first prune is what shows them going apart. On small and medium, the ratio falls, from 2.03 to 1.70 and from 2.16 to 2.01, because these models degrade so sharply that the better-served group loses more in proportional terms. On large-v2 it rises instead, from 1.99 to 2.15, and large-v2 is the one configuration whose aggregate WER improved.
blocks.zh: 差异比率 ^\rho(表4) 以总和不区分三种比例。 在翻版前,它们同样是不平等的,在大v2,2.03的1.99,在小的2.16的2.16,因此,黑人演说者在所有编码器尺度上都面临亚洲演说者大约两倍的字误率. 第一道松树是它们分开的原因 在中小型上,比例从2.03下降到1.70,从2.16下降到2.01,因为这些模型的降解幅度如此之大,以致服务较好的群体损失的比例更高. 在大V2上,它反而从1.99升至2.15,大V2是总WER改进的配置.

blocks.en: Beyond the first pruning, ρ \rho falls on every scale, reaching 1.92 on large-v2 by L-8, while the absolute gap widens at every depth, from 13.5 pp unpruned to 15.0, 18.0, 20.6, and 24.5 pp at L-8 (Table 3 ). This is the divergence anticipated in Section 3.4 : deep pruning drives every group toward high error rates, and the quotient of two large numbers is smaller than that of two small ones even when the difference between them has grown. Our primary measure resolves it, since at L-8 Black speakers face 51.0% WER against 26.5% for Asian speakers. Every scale inherits the disparity, then, but only the largest conceals what pruning does to it.
blocks.zh: 在第一次冲刺之后, à\rho在每一个尺度上跌落, L-8 在大v2上跌落到1.92, 而绝对差距则在每一个深度上扩大, 从13.5pp未冲刺到15.0, 18.0, 20.6, 在L-8上是24.5pp(表3)。 这就是第3.4节中预期的差别:深度的挤压促使每组人出现高误差率,两个大数的商数比两个小数的商数要小,即使它们之间的差值已经增加。 我们的首要措施解决了这一问题,因为L-8黑人发言者的WER比26.5%低51.0%。 那么,每个尺度都继承了这种差异,但只有最大的尺度掩盖了这种差异。

blocks.en: Table 4: Fair-Speech, disparity ratio ρ \rho between Black and Asian speakers, per encoder scale. Italic values lie beyond the usable range (aggregate WER > 40 % >40\% ). Only large-v2 shows a rise at the first prune, where its aggregate WER also improves.
blocks.zh: 表4:按编码器比例,黑人和亚洲语者之间的差距比例 ^\rho。 斜体值超出可使用的范围(总和WER > 40% > 40+)。 只有大V2在第一毛孔显示上升,其总和WER也有改善.

blocks.en: 4.3 The effect of LoRA adaptation (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). LORA 适应的影响(RQ3)

blocks.en: Fig. 4 summarizes the LoRA comparison: each cell is a subgroup’s change in WER relative to the unpruned model (warm colors mean degradation), with the base model in panel (a), the LoRA adapted model in panel (b), and the aggregate in the bottom row; the underlying per-group WERs are in Appendix Table 16 . The LoRA-adapted model is better everywhere: with the unpruned encoder, aggregate WER drops from 21.6% to 17.7%, and at eight removed layers from 37.6% to 33.0%. Adaptation also extends the usable pruning range through ten removed layers, two more than the base model.
blocks.zh: 图4总结了LORA的比较:每个单元格是一个分组相对于未穿透的模型(温色表示退化)的WER的变化,基模型在面板(a)中,LORA调整后的模型在面板(b)中,集合在下行;每个组的WER的基础在附录表16中. LORA的适应型号在各地都比较好:用未喷发的编码器,WER的总和从21.6%下降到17.7%,在8个除层从37.6%下降到33.0%. 适应还可以通过10个被移除的层层,比基准模型多两个层层来扩展可用的推拉范围.

blocks.en: The disparity, however, does not shrink with the error rate. At every depth, the Black-to-Asian ratio is wider with LoRA than without LoRA: at L-0 it rises from 1.99 (base) to 2.20 (LoRA), at L-2 from 2.15 to 2.36, and at L-8 from 1.93 to 2.22. The reason is visible in panel (b): LoRA adaptation compensates the best-performing groups better. At ten removed layers, it recovers 8.0 pp of Asian speakers’ degradation but only 3.3 pp of Black speakers’.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种差距并没有随着误差率而缩小。 在每一个深度,与LORA相比,黑亚比比比比比无LORA要大:在L-0时,从1.99(基数)上升到2.20(LORA),在L-2时从2.15上升到2.36,在L-8时从1.93上升到2.22. 原因可见于小组(b):LORA的适应能更好地补偿表现最好的群体. 在十层,它恢复了8.0pp的亚洲语者退化,但只有3.3pp的黑人语者退化。

blocks.en: 4.4 Beyond Fair-Speech: Common Voice English, Dutch, and Danish
blocks.zh: 4.4 Beyond Fair-Speech:通用语音英语,荷兰语和丹麦语

blocks.en: Table 7: Common Voice Dutch, gender (Whisper large); n n is the number of utterances per group. Male speakers have higher WER at every depth.
blocks.zh: 表7: 共同之声 荷兰语,性别(低声大音);nn是每组话数. 雄性扬声器在每一个深度都有更高的WER.

blocks.zh: 表8:丹麦语(低声大音);n是每组话数. 标有\\dagger的组落到可分析性阈值以下,只报告覆盖范围.

blocks.en: Everything discussed so far comes from Fair-Speech. Fair-Speech provides a comprehensive suite for evaluating multiple demographic disparities. However, it is limited only to the English language. To move beyond English, we also used the demographic labels provided in the CV-22 in different languages. Specifically, we used English, Danish, and Dutch data as in Kolluri et al. (2026) . This also allows us to determine whether the observed effects generalise across datasets and languages. The results reveal a more nuanced pattern: demographic disparities generally persist under pruning, but the concealed amplification observed on Fair-Speech does not consistently transfer to CV-22.
blocks.zh: 目前讨论的一切都来自Fair-Speech. Fair-Speech为评估多种人口差异提供了一套综合套件。 然而,它仅限于英语. 为了超越英语,我们还使用不同语言的CV-22提供的人口标志. 具体来说,我们使用英语、丹麦语和荷兰语的数据,如Koluri等人的数据(2026年)。 这也使我们能够确定所观测到的效果是否跨越数据集和语言。 结果显示一种比较细微的格局:人口差距一般在不断缩小的情况下继续存在,但Fair-Speech上观察到的隐蔽的扩大并没有一贯地转移到CV-22.

blocks.en: CV-22 English provides the clearest contrast (Table 5 ). Speakers with Indian and South Asian accents have the highest WER at every pruning depth, and their absolute disadvantage relative to US speakers grows as more layers are removed. However, the relative disparity remains stable: the WER ratio changes only from 1.42 at L-0 to 1.39 at L-8. Moreover, aggregate WER deteriorates from the first pruning step. Thus, pruning reduces overall performance, but it neither disproportionately amplifies the accent gap nor conceals the degradation from a practitioner monitoring aggregate WER.
blocks.zh: CV-22英语提供了最明显的对比(表5 ). 拥有印度和南亚口音的演讲者在每一波深处都拥有最高的WER,随着更多的层层被移除,他们相对于美国演讲者的绝对劣势不断增大. 然而,相对差距依然稳定:WERR比仅从L-0的1.42变为L-8的1.39. 此外,综合WER从第一个螺旋步骤开始恶化. 因此,挤压会降低总体性能,但不会过度扩大口音差距,也不会掩盖从业者对总和WER进行监测的降解情况。

blocks.en: CV-22 Dutch exhibits the same persistence without amplification (Tables 6 and 7 ; Fig. 8 ). Belgian speakers consistently have higher WER than speakers from the Netherlands, but the ratio remains between 1.1 and 1.3 across pruning depths. The gender axis follows a similar pattern: male speakers have higher WER at every depth, while the ratio remains close to 1.3. These disparities therefore survive pruning but do not systematically widen.
blocks.zh: CV-22 荷兰在不扩大的情况下表现出同样的持久性(表6和7;图8)。 比利时语的WER一直比荷兰语的WER要高,但这一比率仍然在1.1至1.3之间。 性别轴沿类似模式:男性演说者在每一个深度都有较高的WER,而比例仍然接近于1.3. 因此,这些差距继续存在,但没有系统地扩大。

blocks.en: CV-22 Danish marks the limit of the analysis (Table 8 ). Its unpruned aggregate WER is already 35.5%, and the 40% usability threshold is crossed after removing four layers. Demographic annotations are also sparse, with most groups—including all female speakers—falling below the analysability threshold. We therefore treat the Danish results as coverage information rather than evidence for group-level effects.
blocks.zh: CV-22 丹麦标出分析的极限(表8)。 它的未刷总WER已经是35.5%,除去4层后,40%的可用阈值被跨越. 人口统计说明也很少,大多数群体——包括所有女性演讲者——都低于分析阈值。 因此,我们把丹麦的结果视为覆盖信息,而不是群体效应的证据。

blocks.en: Together, these findings answer RQ2. Pruning did not reduce an existing disparity in any evaluated corpus. However, persistent disparities did not necessarily become amplified: on CV-22 English and Dutch, relative gaps remained broadly stable, while aggregate degradation was immediately visible. Concealed disparity amplification occurred only on Fair-Speech with the largest encoder. Evaluating on Fair-Speech does introduce a distribution shift from the Common Voice training data, which may penalize underrepresented linguistic features; however, absolute disparities widened under compression in both our in-domain and out-of-domain settings, so this widening cannot be attributed to corpus shift alone. Consequently, the presence of a baseline performance gap cannot predict how compression will affect a group; the effect must be evaluated separately for each corpus, demographic axis, and model scale.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果共同回答了RQ2. 运行没有减少任何被评估机构的现有差异。 然而,持续存在的差距并不一定会扩大:在CV-22英文和荷兰文中,相对差距仍然大体稳定,而总体退化则立即显现出来。 只有用最大的编码器在Fair-Speech上才出现隐形差异放大。 在Fair-Speech上的评价确实引入了从共同语音训练数据的分布转变,这可能会惩罚代表性不足的语言特征;然而,在我们域内和域外环境的压缩下,绝对差距扩大,因此这种扩大不能仅仅归因于实体转移。 因此,基线性能差距的存在无法预测压缩将如何影响一个群体;必须就每个实体、人口轴和模型尺度分别评估影响。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Demographic bias ( Veliche et al., 2024 ) and layer pruning ( Kolluri et al., 2026 ) have been studied extensively, but their interaction remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate how pruning affects demographic disparities in ASR. On Fair-Speech, removing two layers from Whisper Large slightly improves aggregate WER, while WER for Black speakers increases. The Black-to-Asian WER ratio rises from 1.99 to 2.15, and after removing eight layers, the absolute gap widens from 13.5 to 24.5 pp. Pruning also increases the low-SES vs affluent gap from 5.9 to 7.2 points and more than triples the gender gap. Thus, aggregate improvements can conceal disproportionate degradation among already disadvantaged groups. LoRA improves aggregate WER at every depth but similarly widens the Black-to-Asian ratio by benefiting better-performing groups more. On CV-22 English, Danish, and Dutch, demographic gaps persist but do not clearly amplify, while sparse annotations and high WER prevent reliable group-level conclusions for Danish.
blocks.zh: 人口偏差(Veliche等人,2024年)和地层挤压(Koluri等人,2026年)被广泛研究,但其相互作用仍未得到充分探讨. 在这项工作中,我们调查了挤压如何影响阿拉伯社保组织的人口差异。 在Fair-Speech上,从Whisper Large中移除两层会略微改善聚合WER,而为黑色扬声器的WER则会增加. 黑亚洲WER比从1.99上升到2.15,除去8层后,绝对差距从13.5拓宽到24.5页. Pruning还将低SES与富裕差距从5.9个百分点增加到7.2个百分点,性别差距增加了两倍多。 因此,总体改善可能掩盖本已处于不利地位群体中不成比例的退化。 LORA改进了每个深度的总WER,但同样扩大了黑亚洲比率,使表现较好的群体受益更多。 关于CV-22英文、丹麦文和荷兰文, 人口差距仍然存在, 但并没有明显扩大,

blocks.en: These findings motivate fairness-aware compression objectives that prioritise worst-group rather than average performance. Future work should examine compression methods that not only focus on improving overall performance but also give equal importance to all demographics.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果促使人们认识到公平性的压缩目标优先考虑最坏群体,而不是平均业绩。 今后的工作应审查压缩方法,不仅注重改善总体业绩,而且同等重视所有人口统计。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study investigates a single configuration: Whisper is the only speech encoder with three variants, Qwen2.5-3B the only LLM backbone, and top-down layer pruning the only compression technique. All configurations are trained with a single random seed (42). Since the projector is retrained at every pruning depth, seed replication would multiply across the full grid of encoder scales, depths, and languages, which was beyond our compute budget. To mitigate this, we report paired bootstrap significance over the evaluation set and ground our claims in trends that hold consistently across the sweep rather than in differences within any single configuration. Multi-seed replication remains an important direction for future work. The dataset scope is similarly narrow. The main analysis rests on Fair-Speech, an English read-speech corpus with self-reported demographic labels, and the cross-lingual evidence is thin: pruned Danish models were too degraded for group comparison, and the Dutch corpus records only accent, gender, and age. The demographic axes share speakers and are analyzed separately, leaving intersectional effects unexamined. We evaluate no mitigation techniques.
blocks.zh: 本研究调查单一配置: Whisper是唯一一个具有三个变体的语音编码器,Quen2.5-3B是唯一的LLM主干,自上而下层普润是唯一的压缩技术. 所有配置都通过单随机种子(42)进行训练. 由于投影仪在每一个螺旋深度都重新训练过,种子复制将会在编码器的尺度,深度和语言的全网成倍增加,这超出了我们的计算预算. 为了缓解这种情况,我们报告在评价套子上配对的重要性,并用始终保持的趋势而不是任何单一组合内的差异来证明我们的主张。 多种子复制仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。 数据集范围同样狭窄. 主要的分析依据是Fair-Speech(英语:Fair-Speech),一种带有自报人口标志的英语读写器,跨语言证据很薄:被扭曲的丹麦模型过于退化,无法进行群体比较,而荷兰的本体只记录了口音,性别和年龄. 人口轴线相互交流,并单独分析,使交叉效应得不到审查。 我们不评估减缓技术。

blocks.en: Epoch counts scale inversely with corpus size: English (100 hours) converges within two passes, while Dutch (54 hours) and Danish (4.2 hours) require more passes to converge on their smaller corpora. LoRA configurations are trained for roughly twice as many epochs as projector-only runs, since the adapters are optimised jointly with a projector that is itself trained from scratch. Batch size is reduced to 4 for Danish, whose corpus is too small to fill larger batches without excessive repetition within an epoch. All settings are held constant across encoder scales and pruning depths, so configurations differ only in encoder capacity.

blocks.en:
Common Voice English (Table 5 ) offers a useful contrast
to Fair-Speech. The accent hierarchy is stable, with India/South Asia
trailing US and England at every depth, and the absolute gap grows as
pruning deepens. But there is no concealment window: the aggregate
degrades from the very first prune, so a practitioner watching only the
corpus WER would already see the cost. The relative gap does not widen
either: 1.42 at L-0, 1.39 at L-8.

Dutch shows the same persistence without amplification
(Tables 6 and 7 ,
Fig. 8 ). Belgian speakers trail Netherlands speakers at
every scale and every usable depth, yet the ratio between them stays
essentially flat, between 1.1 and 1.3, across small, medium, and
large-v2 alike. The Dutch gender axis behaves the same way: male
speakers trail at every depth, echoing the Fair-Speech gender direction,
with the ratio flat near 1.3. The inherited gaps survive pruning
unchanged; unlike the racial gap on Fair-Speech, they do not widen, and
they behave the same at every model scale.

blocks.en:
Danish marks the edge of what this analysis can reach
(Table 8 ). Even unpruned, the aggregate WER sits at
35.5%, leaving little headroom: the 40% bound is crossed by six removed
layers. The demographic annotations are also sparse; most groups fall
below the analysability threshold, including all female speakers. We
therefore draw no group-level conclusions for Danish, and the table
documents coverage rather than findings. Together, the three corpora
bound the Fair-Speech result: disparities persist everywhere, but
amplification hidden under an improving aggregate appeared only on
Fair-Speech with the largest encoder.
